units.source_text: 他头戴呢礼帽，身穿高级大衣，围着围巾，

en.t: He wore a felt formal hat, a fine overcoat, and a scarf wrapped around his neck,

units.source_text: 身边带着一个穿着拐红色大衣的女人，一眼就能辨出是个艺技。

en.t: and beside him was a woman in a deep red overcoat, unmistakably a geisha at a glance.

units.source_text: 这张桃红色的丰满的男人脸有点异样，

en.t: That rosy, full male face looked somewhat unusual,

units.source_text: 带有一种娃娃脸般的清洁感、高高的鼻子，

en.t: with a doll-like sense of cleanliness and a high nose,

units.source_text: 这是一张普通中年绅士不易看见的脸……

en.t: a face not often seen on an ordinary middle-aged gentleman...

units.source_text: 这不是外人，正是老师其人的面部特征。

en.t: This was no stranger; it was unmistakably the teacher's own facial character.

units.source_text: 呢礼帽几乎遮住了他的这张面部特征。

en.t: The felt formal hat almost hid those features of his face.
